---
name: Friction report
about: It works, but it cost you round-trips, or an agent used it wrong
labels: friction
---

Nothing is broken, but something made you (or your agent) work harder than the
task deserved. These are worth filing — most of what this tool learned, it
learned from exactly this.

**What you were trying to find out or do.**

**What you actually did** — the sequence, including the calls that turned out to
be the wrong ones. The wrong turns are the useful part: if a tool description
sent an agent down the wrong path, that description is the bug.

**What would have made it one step.**

Examples of things that arrived this way: knowing a task id but having to guess
project × status to find it; a tool answer too large for the model's context;
a queue that looked undelivered because it was read on a different machine.
